The [syllabus](syllabus.qmd) covers how the course runs.
This lecture is about what the course is for:

1.  why hand-designed features run out,
    shown on a dataset of handwritten digits;
2.  what representation learning and deep learning are;
3.  where deep learning sits within machine learning and artificial intelligence;
4.  a short history of neural networks;
5.  the topics and tools of these notes.
